scope: determined the rhGAA ADA epitopes in the plasma of Pompe disease patients using a series of affinity purifications combined with epitope extraction and label free quantitation LC-MS

The antibodies were enriched on immobilized rhGAA beads and were competitively eluted with a rhGAA tryptic digest peptide mixture.
